analytics.description: Post history and the ML model: insights, draft scoring, best posting times.

review_queue.description: Saves drafts for human approval. The agent cannot approve.

meta.description: Facebook Page + Instagram Business: posts, metrics, comments, publish approved drafts.
meta.setup_hint: connect Facebook & Instagram on the Connections page

google_drive.description: Find and read brand assets, briefs and docs; upload files.
google_drive.setup_hint: connect Google Drive on the Connections page

designer.description: Makes on-brand post images locally from brand.json (no account needed).

canva.description: Brand templates, send images to Canva for editing, export PNGs.
canva.setup_hint: connect Canva on the Connections page

buffer.description: Schedule posts across LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.
buffer.notes: Check whether Buffer's API is open to your account. Until then, Facebook scheduling goes through the meta connector.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn company page posts, analytics and comments.
linkedin.notes: Needs LinkedIn Community Management API approval. Use CSV exports for analytics until then.
